calls.title: Neko Health & GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion emphasized a commercial proposal designed for the client’s scale, starting with an enterprise pricing structure of $75,000 per year for unlimited users and five experiments monthly. Conversion metrics indicated a potential $90,000 monthly revenue increase from a 1% lift in conversion rates, directly aligning with the client’s $20 million annual revenue. Key value drivers, like data warehouse integration and advanced statistical capabilities, were highlighted to address stakeholder concerns about speed and security. The importance of rapid onboarding and support was underscored as a competitive advantage, while a clear decision-making framework captured various stakeholder priorities including implementation time and compliance. A follow-up meeting was scheduled to maintain decision momentum.
calls.keywords: Experimentation Platform, Business Case, Statistical Methodology, Enterprise Pricing, Onboarding & Support, Engineering Adoption

calls.title: Neko Health & GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting detailed Necco's strategy to integrate Growthbook for swift experimentation to support its evolving product needs and market expansion, prioritizing onboarding and initial tests within days. Key points included launching a mobile-first strategy with an iOS app followed by Android, aligning mobile and web experimentation, and ensuring seamless data integration with existing tools like Databricks. The discussion also emphasized clear experiment metrics focused on user conversion rates, with insights into real-time data analysis capabilities of Growthbook. Lastly, Growthbook's open-source architecture, supporting compliance and security, was highlighted as a crucial factor for Necco's scaling ambitions in regulated markets.
calls.keywords: Growthbook, Experimentation Platform, Feature Flags, Databricks Integration, Bayesian Statistics, Mobile App Launch
